Stow a 3 star animal on your horse, and be in a solo lobby to increase chances.

all_descriptions: Hanging Dog Ranch at the west end of Big Valley, between 6pm and 6am, seems more common than some. A solo lobby will help a lot.  [#1]

Stow a 3 star animal on your horse, and be in a solo lobby to increase chances.
Twin Rocks near Armadillo during the day is a good one to try. [#2]
Solo lobby, and try a 3 star animal stowed on your horse as well. Pike's Basin next to MacFarlane's Ranch between 6am and 4pm often appears and is next to a fast travel post. [#3]
From Valentine, head west to Cumberland Falls between noon and midnight, there might be one there. Solo lobby, try having a 3 star animal stowed on your horse too. [#4]
